title: Hand Pose Test
description: A webcam-based hand-tracking study that draws hand landmarks and detects a thumb–index pinch in real time.
instructions: Start the preview and allow camera access. Hold your hand in view, then bring your thumb and index finger together to trigger “PINCH!”.

title: Robot Control With AI
description: A hand-gesture-controlled robot simulation with animated movement, turning, and a live camera preview.
instructions: Start the preview and allow camera access. Open palm: stop. Fist: move forward. One finger: turn left. Two fingers: turn right. Bring two open palms together to reset. Keyboard: W/A/D, arrow keys, Space to stop, R to reset.
